8087 {"id":"wt-391-forward-5fx.12","title":"GH-579 T17a implement bounded multi-chunk playback owner","description":"## Goal\nImplement one workspace playback owner that sequences one bounded T15 audio chunk at a time for one active recording.\n\n## Background\nV1 uses immutable rolling chunkDurationMs plus manifest-owned timing returned with each chunk; it has no unbounded timeline, Range request, or all-chunk preload.\n\n## Scope\n- Add a focused playback provider/state machine separate from T08 capture.\n- Consume T15 inventory snapshot fields and complete-chunk endpoint only; never status sidecarPath/hash fields.\n- Compute candidate index from chunkDurationMs, fetch one chunk, validate returned index/start/end timing, and map local/recording elapsed time.\n- Sequence on ended and seek across chunks; missing/failed/deleted candidate becomes explicit unavailable and is never silently skipped.\n- Maintain one audio element/current Blob/object URL; revoke on transition, stop, error, unmount, path/workspace switch, or replacement playback.\n- Pause previous playback before starting another; deduplicate requests and ignore stale responses.\n- Consume the T17c immutable availability snapshot. If active id disappears, transition to out_of_inventory, pause/stop, revoke resources, and refuse auto-advance while its marker retains neutral recording-id navigation.\n\n## Non-goals\nNo polling implementation, capture arbitration, shelf UI, Tiptap, Range, preload, waveform, trimming, word sync, or persistence.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] One audio element/object URL/current Blob exists per workspace owner.\n- [ ] Candidate selection, timing validation, transition, and cross-chunk seek preserve elapsed time.\n- [ ] Every replacement/teardown/error/out-of-inventory path revokes deterministically.\n- [ ] Missing/deleted/failed/out-of-inventory is explicit and never skipped.\n- [ ] Playback does not create its own inventory polling loop.\n\n## Gate commands\n- pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-transcription typecheck\n- pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-transcription test\nPass means state/sequencing/resource tests and full plugin suite exit 0.\n\n## Evidence\nRecord state diagram, timing/seek matrix, fetch/blob/object-URL counters, snapshot consumption, and unavailable behavior.\n\n## Required completion record\n- [ ] Implementation stays inside the stated ownership boundary.\n- [ ] Exact gates pass, or a concrete skip reason and replacement evidence is recorded.\n- [ ] Evidence contains commands, relevant output, changed files, residual risks, and assignment token.\n- [ ] Architecture/docs are updated for public seams, otherwise N/A is recorded.\n- [ ] Focused cross-provider review passes; fix and repeat until clean before STATE impl:done.\n\nNever record secrets, private transcript/audio content, tokens, Authorization headers, or internal artifact paths. Preserve unrelated changes, stable errors, package/workspace isolation, and giant-file guards.\n\n## Browser client ownership\nThis bead exclusively adds the complete-chunk binary method to recordingApiClient (or one named focused sibling) and consumes T15a shared header constants/parser. It must not redefine headers/types or call status(). Playback modules may import only inventory snapshot and chunk-read types; add an import/unit assertion preventing sidecarPath, hashes, or status chunks from entering playback.\n\n## Mount topology\nOwn one workspace-scoped PlaybackProvider mounted beside/inside the existing transcription recording-provider boundary, never per shelf/document and never in MarkdownEditor. Subscribe only to the workspace RecordingInventoryStore availability snapshot from T15f/T17c; no per-document publisher modules or local fetch wrappers. Shelves consume the owner and cannot create audio elements, object URLs, or playback providers.","notes":"Playback selects candidate index from immutable chunkDurationMs, validates manifest-owned timing returned with the bounded audio response, and exposes missing/failed/deleted indexes as unavailable intervals. It subscribes to inventory deletion/unavailability and never silently skips or uses sidecarPath.","status":"closed","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","assignee":"pi-orchestrator","estimated_minutes":120,"created_at":"2026-07-15T14:44:20.412379233Z","created_by":"ubuntu","updated_at":"2026-07-17T04:30:10.131495565Z","closed_at":"2026-07-17T04:30:10.130803237Z","close_reason":"Implemented and independently reviewed GREEN","source_repo":".","compaction_level":0,"original_size":0,"labels":["579","needs-impl","t17","transcription"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"wt-391-forward-5fx.12","depends_on_id":"wt-391-forward-5fx","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-07-15T14:44:20.412379233Z","created_by":"ubuntu","metadata":"{}","thread_id":""},{"issue_id":"wt-391-forward-5fx.12","depends_on_id":"wt-391-forward-5fx.14","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-07-15T16:00:14.076464297Z","created_by":"ubuntu","metadata":"{}","thread_id":""}],"comments":[{"id":26,"issue_id":"wt-391-forward-5fx.12","author":"pi-orchestrator","text":"STATE impl:in_progress — assigned Terra sole writer; fresh Sol review required.","created_at":"2026-07-16T22:26:29Z"},{"id":27,"issue_id":"wt-391-forward-5fx.12","author":"pi-orchestrator","text":"STATE review:paused — Terra implementation 7a54825a + correction bbf8e989a complete and gates pass; final fresh Sol rerun is pending because this Pi session reached the 40/40 subagent spawn cap. T16 node work may change only extension registration/imports and T16 completion work only its command call site; the transcription shelf never adds feature logic to MarkdownEditor.\n\n## Extraction sufficiency gate\nExtract the mount region and extension composition seams far enough that T16d requires only one import/registration line plus its completion call site and T17d requires zero MarkdownEditor body edits. 8895 {"id":"wt-391-forward-5fx.2","title":"GH-579 T15b persist create-time timing and add exact-document inventory query","description":"## Goal\nAdd the recording-store query returning the newest 50 canonical manifests for one exact supported document with stable ordinals and immutable rolling timing metadata.\n\n## Background\nUse canonical manifests only; never scan workspace documents, sidecar folders, or editor DOM, and never create a second persistent index.\n\n## Scope\n- Normalize/validate .md, .markdown, .txt, and .text paths through existing Workspace-safe seams.\n- Filter canonical manifests by exact documentPath.\n- Rank every retained manifest by (createdAt ASC, recordingId ASC), assign ordinal = rank + 1, then project newest-first maximum 50 plus truncated without renumbering.\n- Persist create-time chunkDurationMs on new manifests at recording creation.\n- For legacy manifests missing it, derive a read-only fallback from the maximum positive saved chunk span; never rewrite/migrate them or substitute current policy.\n- Map lifecycle, audio deletion/missing state, chunk count/duration, and stable failure codes to T15a.\n- Keep paths and owner-token material inside the store boundary.\n\n## Non-goals\nNo HTTP/audio read, new index, pagination, ETag, tree scan, legacy-manifest rewrite, UI, or shelf.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] Zero/one/50/>50 plus same-timestamp fixtures prove deterministic rank, newest-first projection, and truncation without ordinal change.\n- [ ] Markdown and plain-text exact paths work; cross-document/unsupported paths cannot leak.\n- [ ] New-manifest persistence and legacy fallback/unavailable behavior are tested.\n- [ ] Audio deletion does not renumber retained recordings.\n\n## Gate commands\n- pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-transcription typecheck\n- pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-transcription test\nPass means focused store tests and full plugin suite exit 0.\n\n## Evidence\nRecord fixture order/ordinals, persisted/fallback timing proof, exact helpers, and confirmation of no second index/tree scan/migration.\n\n## Required completion record\n- [ ] Implementation stays inside the stated ownership boundary.\n- [ ] Exact gates pass, or a concrete skip reason and replacement evidence is recorded.\n- [ ] Evidence contains commands, relevant output, changed files, residual risks, and assignment token.\n- [ ] Architecture/docs are updated for public seams, otherwise N/A is recorded.\n- [ ] Focused cross-provider review passes; fix and repeat until clean before STATE impl:done.\n\nNever record secrets, private transcript/audio content, tokens, Authorization headers, or internal artifact paths. Preserve unrelated changes, stable errors, package/workspace isolation, and giant-file guards.\n\n## Binding manifest-write checklist\n- [ ] Add optional chunkDurationMs to RecordingManifest in server/recordings/types.ts; the canonical plan example is already updated by planning and must not be edited during implementation.\n- [ ] Persist the exact create-time policy in the recordingStore/manifestStore creation writer for every new recording.\n- [ ] Prove a newly started recording's inventory value equals its create-time policy even if current policy later changes.\n- [ ] Keep legacy fallback read-only; never backfill/rewrite an existing manifest.\n\n## Exclusive store/type ownership\nThis bead alone edits RecordingManifest, manifestStore, recordingStore creation/list logic, and shared server recording types. It must finish before T15d. Export/reuse the canonical manifest lookup needed by T15d so the audio-route agent does not edit store/type files.\n\n## Preflight fail-closed gate\nBefore impl:start, verify RecordingManifest, recordingStore create/listManifests, manifestStore, T09 delete-audio/transcript routes, and their focused tests exist and pass. 96103 {"id":"wt-391-forward-5fx.4","title":"GH-579 T15d expose manifest-owned complete chunk audio read","description":"## Goal\nExpose an authenticated complete-chunk audio read resolved only through the canonical recording manifest.\n\n## Background\nLong-recording chunks are independently decodable and bounded by the configured maximum. V1 playback fetches one whole chunk Blob at a time, avoiding Range and aggregate-audio complexity.\n\n## Scope\n- Implement GET /api/v1/transcription/document-recordings/:recordingId/audio/:chunkIndex.\n- Validate recording id and non-negative integer chunk index.\n- Resolve audio only through the canonical manifest and Workspace-safe binary read seam.\n- Require authenticated workspace authority, not the expired capture owner token.\n- Return complete bytes with stored Content-Type and accurate Content-Length plus X-Boring-Recording-Chunk-Index, X-Boring-Recording-Chunk-Start-Ms, and X-Boring-Recording-Chunk-End-Ms from the exact manifest entry, using only T15a shared constants/parser.\n- Reject unsaved, failed, missing, deleted, oversized, or wrong-workspace audio with stable errors.\n- Redact request/access logs and never accept an arbitrary path.\n\n## Non-goals\nNo Range, cache validator, streaming concatenation, transcoding, preload, playback UI, or retention change.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] Valid synthetic WebM bytes round-trip exactly with Content-Type, Content-Length, and exact index/start/end timing headers.\n- [ ] Invalid/deleted/missing/failed/oversized/cross-workspace cases fail before bytes are exposed.\n- [ ] Route tests prove no path or token can influence file selection.\n- [ ] Logs contain no audio body, transcript content, token, or internal path.\n\n## Gate commands\n- pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-transcription typecheck\n- pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-transcription test\nPass means focused binary route tests and full plugin tests exit 0.\n\n## Evidence\nRecord synthetic digest/length plus exact index/start/end header proof, negative-case stable codes, log redaction assertion, and exact manifest-to-Workspace read chain.\n\n## Required completion record\n- [ ] Implementation complete only in the stated ownership boundary.\n- [ ] Exact gates below pass, or a concrete skip reason and replacement evidence is recorded.\n- [ ] Evidence comment contains commands, relevant output, pass/fail, changed files, residual risks, and assignment token.\n- [ ] Architecture/runbook/docs updated when the public contract changes, otherwise explicitly record N/A.\n- [ ] Cross-provider review passes; fix and repeat until clean before posting STATE impl:done.\n\nDo not include secrets, raw audio, private transcript content, owner tokens, Authorization headers, or internal artifact paths in logs or evidence. Preserve unrelated worktree changes and all stable-error/package-boundary invariants.\n\n## Exclusive file ownership\nImplement only the audio route module/test skeleton prepared by T15a0. Do not edit recordings.ts registration, the inventory route module, or the inventory route test file. A retained recording id remains readable regardless of newest-50 list projection; out_of_inventory is not a server error.\n\n## Stabilized store dependency\nT15b owns all manifest/store/type changes and exports the canonical recording/chunk lookup. This bead starts after T15b and only consumes that seam from its exclusive audio route module/test; it never edits recordingStore, manifestStore, or RecordingManifest types.","notes":"Audio read returns one complete manifest-owned chunk plus safe index/start/end timing metadata. Missing, failed, or deleted indexes have stable errors. No arbitrary path, per-chunk-plan endpoint, Range, or unbounded prefetch.","status":"closed","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","assignee":"pi-orchestrator","estimated_minutes":120,"created_at":"2026-07-15T14:41:12.453668659Z","created_by":"ubuntu","updated_at":"2026-08-14T08:19:27.047578308Z","closed_at":"2026-07-16T01:28:04.117662159Z","close_reason":"Implemented by Terra; 98-{"id":"wt-391-forward-5fx.6","title":"GH-579 T16a freeze paired sentinel codec and corruption policy","description":"## Goal\nCreate the pure parser/serializer contract that maps T11 begin/end recording sentinels to a balanced association model without changing persisted Markdown syntax.\n\n## Background\nT11 already writes hidden begin/end comments around ordinary transcript prose. V1 must reuse this format: the begin boundary later renders visibly in Tiptap, the end remains invisible, and non-Tiptap readers continue to see ordinary Markdown plus inert comments. No migration is allowed.\n\n## Scope\n- Define versioned in-memory association metadata for a valid begin/end pair.\n- Parse zero, one, and multiple independent pairs in document order.\n- Serialize valid pairs byte-stably using the exact T11 comment syntax.\n- Detect duplicate recording ids, nesting, reversal, unbalanced boundaries, malformed attributes, and unknown versions.\n- For corrupt input, return a recoverable raw/error result and preserve source unchanged; never auto-repair.\n- Build exhaustive pure fixtures without browser/editor dependencies.\n\n## Non-goals\nNo Tiptap nodes, transaction filter, T11 insertion change, shelf, audio, API, or format migration.\n\n## Acceptance\n- [ ] Valid fixtures round-trip byte-for-byte.\n- [ ] Ordinary prose between boundaries is never parsed into a proprietary transcript node.\n- [ ] Every corrupt class is stable, recoverable, and source-preserving.\n- [ ] Existing T11 fixtures remain compatible.\n\n## Gate commands\n- pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-workspace typecheck\n- pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-workspace test\nPass means focused codec fixtures and the workspace suite exit 0.\n\n## Evidence\nRecord the exact sentinel grammar, fixture matrix, corrupt-result policy, and byte-stability proof.\n\n## Required completion record\n- [ ] Implementation complete only in the stated ownership boundary.\n- [ ] Exact gates below pass, or a concrete skip reason and replacement evidence is recorded.\n- [ ] Evidence comment contains commands, relevant output, pass/fail, changed files, residual risks, and assignment token.\n- [ ] Architecture/docs updated for public seams, otherwise explicitly record N/A.\n- [ ] Cross-provider review passes; fix and repeat until clean before posting STATE impl:done.\n\nNever record private transcript content, raw audio, tokens, Authorization headers, or internal artifact paths. Preserve unrelated worktree changes, stable errors, editor OCC behavior, workspace isolation, and guarded giant-file limits.\\n\\n## Preflight fail-closed gate\nBefore impl:start, verify TranscriptSentinel.ts, insertRecordingTranscriptAtCursor.ts, hasRecordingTranscript behavior, and merged T11 exactly-once tests exist. Stop rather than invent a new serialization/insertion path if absent.","notes":"This pure codec bead is independent of T15 and may start once merged T11 sentinels are present. added pure root-only paired codec with byte-stable valid serialization, source-preserving corruption model, approved safe-integer transcript revision policy, canonical Marked lexical parity, exact CR/LF offset mapping, and post-lex malformed evidence that cannot perturb root eligibility.\nFiles: workspace package/lock direct marked entry; TranscriptSentinel.ts; recordingTranscriptSentinelCodec.ts; focused codec and parity tests.\nGates: workspace typecheck PASS; full workspace suite 1777 passed/10 skipped PASS; focused codec/editor/insertion 52/52 PASS; lint:invariants PASS; 36-case canonical parity PASS; LF/CRLF/CR/mixed offsets PASS; diff/index/artifact checks PASS.\nReview: Sol final GREEN after correction loops; /tmp/579-sol-bead-6-final4.md.\nArchitecture docs: N/A; 226235 {"id":"wt-391-forward-gh912-live-transcript-8r4g.1","title":"G1 prove live HTTP/WS authority and attachment","description":"## Fixed product contract\nImplement GitHub #912 only: /live start \"title\", /live stop, /live status; compact explicit consent; one statically composed singleton; one live session/microphone owner per workspace in one owning app process; stream-only audio to private pinned Kyutai/Moshi stt-1b-en_fr through an authenticated same-origin backend proxy; no audio retention; one timestamped non-diarized Markdown artifact read-only in the live UI; revision-safe projection at most once/second; browser socket close is terminal; only one upstream Kyutai restart; same originating chat stays usable and receives changed-only hidden reviews at +60s then +120s; exact NO_LIVE_RECOMMENDATION is suppressed. Flag remains off until final owner approval.\n\n## Non-goals\nNo MediaRecorder, chunks, upload, playback, pause/resume, browser reconnect, reload/crash recovery, diarization, transcript cards, modes, provider abstraction, generic audio/WebSocket/job/hidden-turn platform, distributed lease, dynamic provider mounting, query credentials, or old recording subsystem integration. Transcript text is untrusted. Stable errors, Workspace-only file access, and repository import invariants apply.\n\n## Scope\nCreate the smallest flag-off contract proof for a core/full-app-owned resolver shared by HTTP mutations and WebSocket upgrades. It must return authenticated principalId, workspaceId, chat-session authority, and resolved Workspace; reject client IDs/raw roots/local-only actor as production authority; reuse host CSRF policy for HTTP; require one canonical allowed Origin for upgrade; and prove a 256-bit hashed single-use pending-attachment capability delivered in the first strict binary message with a 15-second orphan deadline. Start/attachment capability binds principal/workspace/chat/live-session/connection; wrong scope, reuse, expiry, and same-principal competing tabs fail closed. No accepting audio route.\n\n## Repository seams\nInspect packages/core/src/app/server/{createCoreWorkspaceAgentServer,coreWorkspaceBridge}.ts and tests; packages/workspace/src/app/server/createWorkspaceAgentServer.ts only for explicit local-only development composition. Do not widen generic external-plugin auth APIs.\n\n## Acceptance/proof\nAPI-level HTTP+upgrade tests cover valid auth, absent auth, membership/session mismatch, spoofed workspace headers, missing/invalid CSRF, allowed and absent/null/malformed/multi-valued/hostile Origin, attachment redemption/reuse/theft/expiry, and deadline cleanup that revision-safely interrupts when possible and releases lease/lock. Record exact production symbols and commands on issue #912. Feature flag and audio acceptance remain off.\n\n## Status non-disclosure\nUnauthorized, non-member, cross-workspace, cross-session, non-owner, spoofed and capability-only status calls reveal no active path, title, session ID, lease, capability, or upstream detail; return only stable non-secret idle/authorization results after host authority checks.","acceptance_criteria":"Focused core/full-app HTTP+upgrade tests prove: (a) invalid/spoofed HTTP or upgrade authority, CSRF, Origin, and capability redemption fail before live-route Workspace operations or audio acceptance; (b) a valid pending-start expiry uses only its already resolved Workspace, revision-safely marks interrupted when expected bytes still match, revokes capability, and releases lease/lock. Cover membership/session mismatch, same-principal tab race, expiry/reuse, and redaction. Commands: pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-core test; pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-core typecheck; pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-workspace test; pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-workspace typecheck; pnpm audit:imports; git diff --check. Record exact test paths/production symbols.","notes":"INCONCLUSIVE 2026-07-24: isolated worker exceeded its turn budget before an acceptance report/commit; harness removed the temporary worktree, so no proof was retained. 285294 {"id":"wt-391-forward-merge-after-human-approval-rn4m","title":"Workers merge exact-SHA PRs after human approval","description":"Policy change requested by owner.\n\nScope:\n- Update the authoritative factory worker/owner-gate instructions so an implementation worker merges its PR after the owner approves the exact SHA.\n- Preserve safeguards: approval is valid only for the named head SHA and expected target head; all required checks/reviews must be green; if either head moves or mergeability changes, do not merge and re-raise the gate.\n- After a valid approval, merge using the repository-approved method, verify the resulting merge/PR state, then close/complete the bead and report the merge receipt.\n- Remove contradictory “never merge”/“owner merges” wording from directly relevant authoritative docs/templates; do not broaden unrelated orchestration policy.\n- Add or update instruction-contract tests/snapshots if present.\n- Create a separate PR; do not modify PR #1331.\n\nAcceptance:\n1. Trusted worker instructions unambiguously require merge after valid human exact-SHA approval.\n2. Stale approval remains invalid when PR head or target head changes.\n3. Failed/non-clean merge does not bypass review; worker records and re-raises appropriately.\n4. Relevant docs/tests are consistent and green.\n5. Fresh-eyes review, present-pr artifact, and owner approval gate are completed.\n\nBootstrap constraint: the currently loaded trusted instruction still says never merge; this policy PR itself must not violate the loaded rule.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","created_at":"2026-08-19T09:55:14.915713458Z","created_by":"ubuntu","updated_at":"2026-08-19T09:55:14.915713458Z","source_repo":"boring-ui-v2","source_repo_path":"/home/ubuntu/projects/boring-ui-v2","compaction_level":0,"original_size":0,"labels":["factory","policy"]}

287296 {"id":"wt-391-forward-n9bd","title":"File surfaces need tabs: opening several files in a row shows only the last","description":"GH #1297.\n\nSymptom: an agent opening several files in a row to show the user leaves only the LAST one visible; each open replaces the previous.\n\nSource: openFile has no tab-vs-replace notion. UI_FILE_OPEN_MODES (shared/types/filesystem.ts:20) is only view|edit|diff — how the CONTENT renders. The command carries {path, mode?, filesystem?} (shared/ui-bridge.ts:20) and uiCommandDispatcher.ts:128 calls surface.openFile(path) on the single file surface, so consecutive opens overwrite. openPanel carries an explicit id so panels coexist; files have no equivalent identity.\n\nAsk: multi-file representation (tabs) so opened files coexist.\n\nDesign notes: re-opening the SAME path must stay idempotent (no duplicate tabs); likely an open disposition (replace|newTab) defaulting to today's behaviour so nothing regresses; bound the tab count so a loop cannot open hundreds.","notes":"worker_session_id=session_pr1301_followup_20260819T194959Z; pr=#1301; owner_request_changes_followup; exact_initial_head=40eeb10e74243850655ca7f4ccba2b0c7da12908; no_merge","status":"in_progress","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","assignee":"session_pr1301_followup_20260819T194959Z","created_at":"2026-08-14T19:29:29.541640109Z","created_by":"ubuntu","updated_at":"2026-08-19T19:50:28.639684499Z","source_repo":"boring-ui-v2","source_repo_path":"/home/ubuntu/projects/boring-ui-v2","compaction_level":0,"original_size":0,"comments":[{"id":303,"issue_id":"wt-391-forward-n9bd","author":"ubuntu","text":"Reframed (see GH #1297 comment): routing defect, not missing feature. main already has inline chat artifacts (front/primitives/artifact.tsx + ArtifactOpenContext, wired into PiChatPanel) AND plural intention artifacts; only exec_ui openFile is single-slot. 322331 {"id":"wt-391-forward-oueu","title":"PiPlatform seam — one interface between UI surfaces and the agent runtime","description":"From the pi-v2 removal-map analysis (docs/plans/multiagent-shell/research/pi-v2-removal-map.md + pi-v2-alignment.md, 2026-08-26). WHAT: introduce one stable internal interface (PiPlatform: connection/sessions/chat/transcript/models/accounts) between Boring UI surfaces and the agent runtime; implement it as an adapter over the CURRENT gateway/pi-0.80.7 path; components stop importing pi internals directly. Adoption-neutral: pays off whether or not we ever jump to pi v2 (a future v2 adapter slots behind the same seam). Constraints: the D29 AgentGateway seven-method contract is KEPT (the seam sits above/inside it, consumers never talk to pi directly); durable session storage stays host-owned (hard rule 9). NOT substrate-free (touches sessions/transport) — dispatch ordering belongs to DIRECTION; do not claim from br ready before DIRECTION schedules it. Proof path: seam interface + current-adapter landed; an import-lint rule forbidding direct pi-internal imports from front components; existing chat flows green through the seam. Likely 2 sessions (seam+adapter / migrate imports+lint).","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","created_at":"2026-08-26T20:56:51.030950386Z","created_by":"ubuntu","updated_at":"2026-08-27T10:18:59.286251902Z","source_repo":".","compaction_level":0,"original_size":0,"comments":[{"id":990,"issue_id":"wt-391-forward-oueu","author":"ubuntu","text":"Priority raised P2->P1 (owner direction 2026-08-27): the PiPlatform seam is the insurance that makes the no-waste split real — durable-streams' neutral layer is written against it, so the deferred store piece can be swapped (ours or pi v4) without touching consumers. Dispatch alongside the durable-streams neutral layer.","created_at":"2026-08-27T08:53:36Z"},{"id":993,"issue_id":"wt-391-forward-oueu","author":"ubuntu","text":"RENAMED CONCEPT (canonical sync, 2026-08-27): the seam is AgentHarnessBackend — a PRIVATE backend interface UNDER the D29 gateway (openSession/importSession/readSnapshot/watchEvents/submitPrompt/abortOperation/inspectOperation/closeSession). UI components NEVER depend on it; they depend on the gateway only. It owns no accounts/credentials/payer/membership/model-eligibility/billing/seat-identity — those stay above it in Boring. This bead's UI-side import-lint proof becomes: no component imports pi internals OR the backend seam; gateway only.","created_at":"2026-08-27T10:18:59Z"}]}

395404 {"id":"wt-391-forward-shell-ngfs.3","title":"Shell L1.5 — shell location contract","description":"WHAT: ShellLocation type, reducer, navigate(), and the host serialization seam.
